title.value: Functional Commitments and SNARGs for P/poly from SIS
Functional Commitments and SNARGs for P/poly from SIS

abstract.value: We present new constructions of succinct non-interactive functional commitments and arguments for circuits (i.e., P/poly), based on the SIS assumption without random oracles. For boolean circuits of depth. d and size. s over .l-bit inputs, w e obtain-a non-interactive functional commitment scheme with .O(1)-sized transparent CRS, .O(1)-sized commitment, and .O(d)-sized op enings;-a non-interactive succinct argument (SNARG for P/poly) with.O(1)sized transparent CRS, and .O(d)-sized unambiguous pro ofs. Here, .O(•) hides .poly(λ, log l, log s) factors. Moreover, both schemes support fast online verification after a circuit-dependent pre-processing phase, and do not impose a bound on circuit parameters during setup. Our constructions are simple, self-contained, and completely elementary: we rely only on simple algebraic operations and do not utilize correlation intractability, sum-check, or non-black-box use of cryptography.
